signmaking-heritage-tour.name: signmaking-heritage-tour
notes: Two original generic storefront signs attach to a freestanding display backing; backing contacts a broad foot. Raised OPEN lettering and oval star sign are original motifs, not copied collection objects. A small caption card indicates exhibition interpretation; no navigation arrow.

foraging.name: foraging
notes: Open paper bag rests on bottom and has four continuous walls/folded rim. Stems extend into bag rather than float above it. Generic leaves and a closed field guide indicate guided foraging without asserting a species, edibility, medicinal effect or actual kit. Primary asks participants to bring collecting bags.

candle-making.name: candle-making
notes: Original grounded hollow pouring pitcher with connected handle/spout, unlit pillar with centered wick, raw wax slab and wick spool. No floating pouring action, flame, recipe, exact kit, wax type or event method promised. Container/mold/wick relationships use manufacturer structural text.

monotype.name: monotype
notes: Original smooth rigid plate painted directly, with a separate mirrored paper impression. Brush rests alongside plate; no carved relief or gel plate assumed. Primary confirms Plexiglas and press-assisted transfer; this depicts the painted plate and result, not an invented press model or complete transfer sequence.
